name: cortex
description: Durable Cortex control plane for staged agent work: tasks, gates, delegations, locks, and handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate staged work across Codex agents
interface.longDescription: Adds 21 bundled agent profiles, 10 skills, and a local opt-in Cortex v7 ledger with receipt-backed worker reports, staged gates, incremental knowledge harvests, and full source-backed refreshes. Requested model and reasoning effort remain the parent Codex dispatch decision and are resolved against host capabilities.
interface.defaultPrompt: Coordinate this task with Cortex. Use help, harvest, or harvest-refresh when that exact route is requested.
